subject: mathematics
title: Rounding Ramp · Q2 W04 D03
objective: Round numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand.
introduction: Milo found 47 shells and wants to round them! 🐚 Help him round 47 to the nearest ten — 7 is 5 or more, so it goes up to 50.

vocabulary.definition: 47 rounds up to 50 because the next digit is 7, which is 5 or more.
342 rounds down to 300 because the next digit is 4, which is less than 5.
3,650 rounds up to 4,000 because the hundreds digit 6 is 5 or more.

items.prompt: Answer this one: Round 47 to the nearest ten.  (in this lesson: Rounding Ramp)
items.explanation: 47 is between 40 and 50. The ones digit is 7, and 7 is 5 or more, so 47 rounds up to 50.

items.prompt: Round 342 to the nearest hundred.  (in this lesson: Rounding Ramp)
items.explanation: 342 is between 300 and 400. The tens digit is 4, and 4 is less than 5, so 342 rounds down to 300.

items.prompt: Round 3,650 to the nearest thousand.  (in this lesson: Rounding Ramp)
items.explanation: 3,650 is between 3,000 and 4,000. The hundreds digit is 6, and 6 is 5 or more, so it rounds up to 4,000.

items.prompt: Round 1,241 to the nearest hundred.  (in this lesson: Rounding Ramp)
items.explanation: 1,241 is between 1,200 and 1,300. The tens digit is 4, which is less than 5, so it rounds down to 1,200.

items.prompt: Milo has 47 candies. About how many candies does he have, to the nearest ten?
items.explanation: 47 is closer to 50 than to 40, and the ones digit 7 is 5 or more, so 47 rounds up to 50.
